text_block_list.text:
Born into the prestigious Mejiro family, 
Mejiro Palmer wanted to escape the Mejiro 
brand and live true to herself, but 
thought it would be difficult.

Then, one day, she ran in a freestyle 
race. Basking in cheers from her runaway 
lead, she discovered the joy of running 
freely.

Furthermore, she became besties for life 
with Daitaku Helios, who shared her talent 
for explosive runaway leads.

Mejiro Palmer cast aside all expectations 
and decided to run as a gyaru. As the 
Mejiro party girl, she'll aim straight for 
the top!
